items.title: Started Coding Journey
items.description: Began learning HTML, CSS, and JavaScript out of sheer curiosity. Built first web pages and knew this was it.

items.title: First GitHub Push
items.description: Published my first project on GitHub. Started building a public portfolio of small apps and experiments — messy but mine.

items.title: Entered IoT & Embedded
items.description: Started experimenting with ESP8266 and Arduino. Built home automation projects — lights, sensors, relays. The physical world meets code.

items.title: HP LIFE Ambassador
items.description: Selected as an HP LIFE Ambassador to promote digital skills and entrepreneurship education in my community.

items.title: Started B.Tech at UIT (AKTU)
items.description: Began my B.Tech in Computer Science & Engineering at United Institute of Technology, Prayagraj — affiliated with Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University.

items.title: Hacktoberfest 2025
items.description: Contributed to open-source projects during Hacktoberfest and earned the official completion badge.

items.title: Built SMSController
items.description: Released SMSController — an Android app for remote device control via SMS. My most technically ambitious project yet.
